title: Whafful's Wool Block Sets
description: Retextures some blocks to have wool textures to mimic 26.3's new wool block sets.
body:
This resource pack retextures various blocks to have wool textures, allowing players to play with the new 26.3 block sets before they're officially available.

![Wool Block Set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/faed27b0aa1a86a20312303d03621d226243c0d2.png)

Retextures the following blocks to have the following wool textures:

Smooth Red Sandstone -> Red Wool

Resin Bricks -> Orange Wool

Endstone Bricks -> Yellow Wool

Block of Quartz -> Lime Wool

Mossy Stone Bricks -> Green Wool

Prismarine -> Cyan Wool

Prismarine Bricks -> Light Blue Wool

Dark Prismarine -> Blue Wool

Purpur -> Purple Wool

Red Nether Bricks -> Magenta Wool

Smooth Quartz Block -> Pink Wool
